name: Außerwieserhof
beschreibung: The Außerwieserhof is situated on the outskirts of Neustift in the Stubai Valley (Stubaital), surrounded by meadows and mountain scenery. The building is a traditional Tyrolean farmstead operated as an inn. Guests can expect a simple, cozy atmosphere featuring authentic regional cuisine and understated yet well-kept rooms. The ambiance is peaceful and rural. The inn is ideal for travelers seeking tranquility and pristine nature without requiring elaborate luxury.
